faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How long does it take to install a solar system?
faq.answer1: A typical residential installation takes 1 to 3 days, depending on the system size and complexity.
faq.question2: What maintenance is required for solar panels?
faq.answer2: Solar panels require minimal maintenance. We recommend periodic cleaning and an annual check-up by our team.
faq.question3: Are there subsidies for solar systems in Macedonia?
faq.answer3: Yes, there are various subsidy programs. Our team can help you find and apply for available options.
